lede: Georgia Tech carries the stronger underlying team rating — -1.0 against -1.2, a 0.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Stanford +3.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Georgia Tech winning 60% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass offense, where Georgia Tech leads Stanford by 66 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
